name: untitled monkey game
desc:
escape the monster. you're an ape with no legs, just arms. push off the floor and walls to run, climb and leap.

how to play
⏳ survive for as long as you can 
🐒 run, climb and hide. avoid being caught
🔨 stun the monster with weapons and save your friends
👹 or play as the monster and catch every monkey

controls
[wasd] move  [shift] sprint  [space] leap
[e] pick up  [click] attack  [g] drop
[q] hand talk  [mash space] break free

monster
[click] to attack 

💬 join our community! link in the socials below
